name: git-graph
description: A GRAPH tab for the active repository: every branch's commits as a lane graph with their branch, remote and tag labels. Click a commit for its changed files and their diffs; right-click a commit or a ref label to check out, branch, tag, cherry-pick, revert, reset or delete.

gitGraph.pollInterval.description: How often (ms) the open GRAPH tab checks whether any ref moved, reloading only when one did. Runs only while the tab is the active one - an inactive or closed tab makes no requests.

gitGraph.showRemoteBranches.description: Include remote-tracking branches in the graph. Off draws only local branches, tags and stashes, which on a repository with many stale remote branches is a much shorter graph.
